The library design workshop

Unit 1 · Week 14 · Lesson 2 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open the network-review chapter and its learning resources. Use paper or a local editor as appropriate, with fictional data and disposable practice copies. The suggested 55-minute lesson is flexible.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. The library design workshop

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Explain the goal and the expected independent outcome. Combine addressing, media and access decisions. This is ungraded textbook learning. Suggested times can be adjusted to the class. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#network-review. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

2. Retrieval and explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual retrieval, then partner comparison

For the ordinary practice /24, .0 is network and .255 broadcast. Host interface allocations must be distinct, including the gateway and server. Allow silent thinking before discussion. Ask a learner to justify an answer before revealing the explanation. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#network-review. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

3. Library requirements

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked table and teacher explanation

Use the chapter’s unchanged fictional brief. Do not invent a precise building distance or price. State assumptions where the scenario lacks facts. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#network-review. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

4. A server allocation

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Predict, model and explain

An allocation such as .40.20–31 gives twelve desktop addresses without reusing .1 or .10. Other coherent plans are acceptable. Pause for predictions before discussing the expected result. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#network-review. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

5. A design critique

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

Require specific feedback about a link, address, access rule or evidence gap. Teacher checks the course diagram symbols. Swap explaining and checking roles so both learners articulate the reasoning. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#network-review. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

6. Independent practice

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application with optional support

Look for complete coverage of the brief. Allow alternate justified designs. This is ungraded practice with public explained answers. Offer the relevant worked example if needed, then use a changed case to check independent understanding. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#network-review. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

7. A choice to explain

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Whole-class response and justification

B. Performance and access protection are separate requirements. Give thinking time and collect reasons, without recording scores. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#network-review. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

8. Exit explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual reflection and fresh explanation

Check concrete evidence against the brief rather than a general statement that the design works. Use the response to select the next explanation or practice activity. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#network-review.
